container_uids.details: Verified 3 critical containers (oauth2-proxy, session-broker, caddy) run as non-root

docker_compose_directives.details: All user: directives present in docker-compose.yml

docker_socket_mounts.details: No insecure docker.sock root mounts found

image_defaults.details: Standard images include non-root users (overridable by compose)

notes.oauth2-proxy: Runs as UID 101 (oauth2-proxy user in official image)
notes.session-broker: Runs as UID 1000 (application-defined user, requires docker access for spawning sessions)
notes.caddy: Runs as UID 33 (www-data/caddy user, can still bind to ports via capabilities)
notes.security: Non-root execution reduces attack surface and container escape risk
notes.docker_socket: session-broker must access docker.sock but runs as non-root; host must allow user 1000 docker access (e.g., docker group membership)
